purpose: Label-free structure intake from newly acquired primary human A2A functional literature.
historical_visibility_basis: The publications predate the project cutoff, but these candidate structures were not found in the pre-freeze Track 3 repository sources or artifacts. Automated exact-structure and generic-scaffold screening remains mandatory.

sources.title: Identification of nanomolar adenosine A2A receptor ligands using reinforcement learning and structure-based drug design
sources.structure_authority: RCSB PDB Chemical Component Dictionary and OPSIN systematic-name resolver
sources.structure_resolution_note: Compound 5 was resolved from its exact systematic name in the primary supporting information using OPSIN. Two compound 4 stereoisomers were deferred because the supporting information explicitly marks their absolute configurations as unknown.

sources.title: Systematic metabolite screening identifies functional regulators of the adenosine A2A receptor
